chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, from someone else, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was paved with red gravel.

key_terms.قَبْرُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The grave of the Messenger of Allah
key_terms.مُحَصَّبٌ: Paved with small stones or gravel

ai.seo_question: What was the grave of the Prophet Muhammad covered with according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the specific material used for the Prophet's grave—red gravel (ḥaṣbāʾ)—which serves as a primary evidentiary basis in Shia jurisprudence for the permissibility and recommendation of covering graves with stone or plaster. It underscores the distinct status of the Prophet's resting place within the Prophet's Mosque, distinguishing it from other graves and reinforcing the tradition of honoring the Ahl al-Bayt through physical beautification of their burial sites.
